raw_content: Enquiry from web form. Name: Priya Sharma. Company: Nova Beauty Group. Message: Launching a new skincare line, need a venue for ~150 people, sometime in late April or early May 2027 (flexible on exact date). Budget around HK$3,500 per head. Prefer a modern, minimalist space, no strict district preference. Duration about 3 hours including a press segment.
